snippet.title: The Flash Video Game: Running Combat Sample
snippet.description: This is early game footage from the unfinished Flash video game made by Bottlerocket Entertainment in 2008.  When our publisher Brash folded we were about 6 months into full production with about a year still to go on the game so please excuse the roughness of how it looks at this stage. This short video shows a brief sample of what our running combat was starting to develop as.  We were shooting for a "Road Rage" kind of feel to it where you could bump and slam into your opponent until you made him wipe out.  This sample is only about a weeks worth of work so we still had a long way to go on it.  Enjoy!
